name: shared_name
title: Two people with one name stay two people
why: Sarah Chen at Globex and Sarah Chen at Initech are different people. A memory keyed on names quietly merges them, and every question about either returns a chimera. The probes are entity-scoped on purpose: a system that cannot address an entity, only a name, cannot express the distinction, and reports here as unsupported rather than passing by accident.

events.speaker: agent:witness_a
events.text: Sarah Chen, who works at Globex, leads their data platform team.

events.speaker: agent:witness_a
events.text: A different Sarah Chen works at Initech as a procurement manager.

probes.question: What is held about the Globex Sarah, and only her?
What is held about the Initech Sarah, and only her?
